programme.title: 模範家庭
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽鬱香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的祕密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: Red Rain (AKA Love Rain)
programme.desc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他遊說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。

programme.title: 青春鼓王
programme.desc: 船員孫志強巧合成爲「火花大樂隊」的鼓手,他因急於成名,答應幫助音樂雜志出版人李源明接近樂隊經理黃麗真,以換取源明的力捧。終於,志強得償所願,一炮而紅,源明卻逼他實踐諾言,與麗真斷絕來往。志強受到極大打擊,唯有忍痛離開樂隊與麗真

programme.title: 鬥氣小神仙
programme.desc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校,因二人的母親一向口和心不和,從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想,因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大,三日一小吵,五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅,很快成為情侶,兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友…

programme.title: 斷魂谷
programme.desc: 斷魂谷趙家莊主趙雲陽有兩弟子,趙玉龍和趙劍英。玉龍終年浪蕩江湖,卻得雲陽所有財産。劍英不憤,害死師父嫁禍玉龍,幷引其子金虎追殺玉龍。兩人在斷魂穀決鬥,劍英欲收漁人之利,幸金虎和玉龍發現穀中有埋伏,詐傷引出主謀,連手反攻

programme.title: 雲泥
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症,一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非,多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。

programme.title: 清宮大刺殺
programme.desc: 雍正雄才大略,殘忍狠毒,特組「血滴子」特務集團,以作暗殺反清人士的工具。不料,馬騰不值雍正濫殺無辜,乃叛變潛逃出宮。雍正怕後患無窮,命御前侍衛剛振風及宣寶鷹,務必將馬緝拿到手。馬攜妻兒在昔日同僚追殺下,輾轉逃亡,匿於江南,開設打鐵館,並發明鐵傘以破血滴子

programme.title: 三十年細說從頭
programme.desc: 大導演李翰祥改編自己大受歡迎的專欄,盡現電影圈光怪陸離的趣事及傳聞,由愛將劉永和戴良純扮演不同角色,保證令你捧腹大笑。

programme.title: 俠士行
programme.desc: 嚴太師遇刺斃命,護衛範義追擊刺客至窮巷,見他踏鏢逾牆逸去,而鏢乃寇英之器,範遂遍城貼滿通緝寇的畫像。寇取得遇害縣官宋化龍身上的公文,得以入城,卻仍為範捉拿,幸得酒店店主的女兒雪娘,自認寇是其表哥,寇才倖免被捕;寇向雪道出自己的身份及真相。其後,範遭假扮成寇的寨主賀西雷襲擊,而救回他的竟是……

programme.title: 摩登土佬
programme.desc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。

programme.title: 刺馬
programme.desc: 張汶祥、黃縱與馬新貽三人是結拜兄弟,可惜因為馬新貽為達目的貪贓枉法,更傾慕黃縱的妻子,導致三人關係破裂,最終更血腥收場。

programme.title: 乾隆下揚州
programme.desc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡,這次得大臣和大學士陪行,他們一行三人來到揚州,期間遇上不少趣事。

programme.title: 妖魂
programme.desc: 盛傳很多武林中人在一夜間離奇消失,機智少俠欲查明真相,怎料當他發現原來是妖魂作怪時,他自己亦已身陷險境

programme.title: 風流韻事
programme.desc: 本片講述了三個故事。《蕭翼賺蘭亭》講述唐太宗李世民收盡天下王羲之的書法,獨缺《蘭亭序》,御史蕭翼多才多藝,設計從辯才和尚那裡騙取《蘭亭序》《蕙蓮》以林偉圖設計謀殺李鵬飛為序幕,以李在橋上看奇書《金瓶梅》展開劇情;而《小神仙》則又由偷牛、捉姦和小神仙同藥師之間的鬥法三個小故事組成。

programme.title: 出籠馬騮
programme.desc: 故事描述,程小東因誤殺罪入獄,一死囚臨終前交予他半爿銅牌,囑他尋找另半爿銅牌,當會知其妙用。後程在獄中結識侯朝聲,一同逃獄;逃亡期間二人得悉銅牌牽涉到一段江湖恩怨,且始知彼此身上均有半爿銅牌,一湊合即出現「長白之巔,猛虎之嶺」八個字,另有山脈圖絞,二人憑線索去到長白山猛虎嶺找出「通臂拳」祕笈,遂苦練拳法以力敵追兵

programme.title: 中華丈夫
programme.desc: 何滔乃日本華裔商人之子,長大後武藝超凡。滔承父之命與日商之女弓子結婚,豈料妻子原來也練得一身出色的日本武術,兩人不時為鬥氣而比武。有日弓子更鬥氣返回孃家,滔圖以激將法寫信約弓子回來比武,豈料信被其他日本人看到,以為滔想向日本武術宣戰,滔遂與日本武術界展開連場激鬥…

programme.title: 玫瑰我愛你
programme.desc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。

programme.title: 玫瑰我愛你
programme.desc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。

programme.title: 第三類打鬥
programme.desc: 全片由“天堂、“人間、“地獄 三個故事組成,帶領觀眾穿梭三個時空。巡宮仙使辛靈,則是貫穿全片的核心人物。他最初因掩護仙界同僚逃出天宮, 而被貶落凡間,在人間因營救逃亡夫婦,不幸重傷身亡,到了地獄又協助冤鬼殺死仇敵。

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 年輕書生寧採臣在傳說鬧鬼的恐怖寺廟裡過夜。雖然他不相信傳聞,卻遇上美麗的女鬼聶小倩。原來聶小倩被困在寺廟中,誘使年輕男子給魔頭姥姥享用。寧採臣得悉聶小倩為一隻善良的女鬼,於是決定助她逃離魔掌。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳續集
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?

programme.title: 獵人
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。

programme.title: 洪文定三破白蓮教
programme.desc: 白蓮教主六十餘歲,紅顏白髮,練就絕招,能閉全身穴道,武功高深莫測,卻甘作滿清鷹犬,暗中協助師侄高進忠,消滅反清志士及破壞重建少林寺;洪文定為少林英雄洪熙官之子,曾擊斃白之師弟白眉道人,名震江湖。白與高偵知洪住反清志士胡亞彪家中,夜襲殺胡及其妹,洪幸護著身懷六甲的胡妻突圍逃走

programme.title: 花木蘭
programme.desc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。

programme.title: 鳳飛飛
programme.desc: 鳳飛飛為報姊仇,發現兇手竟為未來夫婿金連白,不知所措。而殺姊夫之兇手蕭豹與梁霸為除後患,與金夫人聯手對付飛飛,欲滅絕鳳家。飛飛怒不可遏,合父母之力將惡賊擊斃。

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋,其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿,意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出,孝文感於貞蓮真情,決意回鄉稟明母親,迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後,貞蓮萬念俱灰,竟狂飲毒酒,以圖自盡

programme.title: 大旗英雄傳
programme.desc: 鐵中棠乃大旗門掌門雲翼之義子,因門派寶藏之祕密而遭宿敵司徒笑追殺。為解開身世與寶藏之謎,他遠赴長春島尋訪「日後」,卻發現她早已離世。豈料在島上意外遇見大旗門真正的創派掌門「夜帝」,而夜帝亦親口揭露,自己正是鐵中棠的生父。

programme.title: 三笑
programme.desc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂決定隱瞞身份,進入華家作書僮,藉此接近秋香,並向她表明自己的身份和來意,可惜秋香並不相信。最後,唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下,終於抱得美人歸。

programme.title: 八萬罪人
programme.desc: 香港在1953至1955年,曾被警方稱為最黑暗的時期,那時候罪惡泛濫,百弊叢生,一日可發生三十二宗驚人案件,而犯罪份子有百分之四十是積犯;英廷特派專員來港調查監獄的措施,發現獄中不良份子,濫用權力,公報私仇,歪曲政府的監獄制度,造成犯人越變越黑,監獄變成地獄。影片主角江才因不甘受探長侮辱,結果被控妨礙公務,判刑一年零八個月

programme.title: 銷魂玉
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意,許下三個願望,雖然願望靈驗之極,結果落得家散人亡;風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死,變成水鬼復仇;豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後,仍不斷在人間走動,盜墳賊欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶,終被蕭雲玉追殺致死

programme.title: 釣金龜
programme.desc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去臺北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……

programme.title: 釣金龜
programme.desc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去臺北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家,為奴以埋父骨;其孝心感動了七仙女,便幻成村姑,在六位仙姐下凡暗助下,為董縮減償還工作日,回復自由後,二人回董故家,但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢?

programme.title: 火併
programme.desc: 大同府著名銀號福來錢莊,內儲黃金逾百萬兩,使各方賊寇垂涎。獨腳大盜滕奇影本欲邀錢莊護院文禮賢合謀,將錢莊金銀據為己有,但文嚴拒;滕轉向白氏姊妹玉燕及玉鶯著手,共襄劫金大舉……

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一羣年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。

programme.title: 血灑天牢
programme.desc: 宋末,大元初把天下統一,元帥將宋丞相文天祥打入天牢,意圖說服其歸元,亦希望借機將往救文之抗元義士一網打盡。義士之一白鴨兒在拯救途上,遇著「金掌」樂何如,忙邀共同救國,但樂自認跟蹤白為貪圖美色,救國非少數人所能為,拒絕後旋即逸去。及後,一眾義士為救文,紛紛藉故犯法,先後成功被關入天牢,白竟在天牢再遇樂

programme.title: 梁山伯與祝英臺
programme.desc: 祝英臺既為女兒身,卻穿男兒裝上學堂,與同窗梁山伯結下生死之愛。山伯得悉真相後,前往祝家求親,豈料英臺已被許配他人,二人被迫分開。山伯傷心欲絕,一病不起。英臺驚聞噩耗,哭墳跳進墓裡殉情。

programme.title: 楚留香
programme.desc: 某天,俠盜楚留香歡宴好友無花和尚,神水宮的宮南燕突然來到,指稱楚盜去神水宮的天一神水,且用以毒殺多人。在楚留香極力否認下,宮南燕表示他需於一個月內找出真兇,否則必將置其於死地。楚留香為證明自身清白,決意著手調查此事件

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。

programme.title: 天下第一拳
programme.desc: 故事描述,顧文宗飾的老拳師突遭百武館館徒襲擊,幸汪萍飾的女兒及羅烈飾的弟子救駕;顧自知年邁力衰,不足為羅師,亦恐邪派奪全國錦標,遂面諭羅改投尚武館習藝,以奪魁為期許。羅途遇王金鳳飾的賣唱女遭調戲,王獲救後欲以身相許,羅心中有汪遂拒王;後羅屢遭百武館徒滋擾,更為外援日本浪人所傷

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。

programme.title: 獵魔者
programme.desc: 鉅富之女賀盈聘請羅力到柬埔寨,從殺手乃汶處奪回商業祕密錄音帶。羅與好友組織一支敢死隊,直赴遊擊隊基地,成功將錄音帶交到賀手上後,方發現背後原來有極大的密祕

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素,欲與其結合,央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親,撮合一段人鬼姻緣,馬素年青憨直,不願與鬼為伍,堅決拒絕,實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,決定伺機行動。

programme.title: 黑靈官
programme.desc: 人稱「黑靈官」的宮天龍,押解殺人犯關雲飛時遇上大風雪,被迫在宮天龍家留宿。當晚關雲飛獲同夥所救,逃脫前更砍殺宮天龍之母及幼妹。其後,宮天龍因押解囚犯不利,被打入大牢。宮天龍出獄後,誓要殺死關雲飛為家人報仇。

programme.title: 少林子弟
programme.desc: 明末明將吳三桂賣國降清引狼入室,大明江山亦為滿清所併,舉國有氣節之士無不感悲憤。少林子弟紛紛下山,串聯各地好漢抗清復明;清官招降納叛,廣收武當、峨嵋派的江湖敗類,勾結地方惡霸,向少林子弟趕盡殺絕,洪、方、胡等處在重重危機險惡之中

programme.title: 徐老虎與白寡婦
programme.desc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作,獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄,再加上責令嚴緝私鹽,二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網,白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死,一心復仇…

programme.title: 來的都是客
programme.desc: 影片反映在改革開放中依靠竹編工藝發展起來的鄉鎮企業,為謀生存,求銷路,鄉幹部們違心地接二連三地接待自上而下的參觀團,檢查團等各路食客甚至白食者。nn 竹林鄉竹編工藝社銷路看好,為應付各路來客,其領頭人肖望發(趙本山飾)開始兼管食堂。

programme.title: 金婚
programme.desc: 影片以散文般的風格和結構把兩個老人的晚年生活娓娓道來,平淡中帶著無聊,含蓄中帶著無奈,如果沒有對婚姻與家庭的體驗恐怕難以對影片發出會心一笑或由衷的歎息。

programme.title: 溫哥華醬油樂隊
programme.desc: 從小就期待著去找媽媽和妹妹的蘇盼,帶著父親的臨終囑託,踏上了加拿大的尋親路。看望多年不見的媽媽安娜和孿生妹妹蘇瞳。n三人最初的相處十分尷尬。安娜無論如何也走不進兒子蘇盼的內心。叛逆的妹妹更對這個`陌生人不屑一顧。而蘇盼懷著對當年母親離

programme.title: 第五行動組I對決
programme.desc: 由於叛徒的出賣,汪偽特務機構七十六號殘忍的殺害了第五組,為了給同志們報仇,以楊勵為首的第五行動組制定了刺殺七十六號大頭目——孔天佑的計畫。n楊勵為了打探孔天佑的行蹤,終日扮成社交名流流連於聲色場所,卻意外發現了學生時期的革命進步分子高一峯。

programme.title: 舞臺姐妹
programme.desc: 描寫越劇藝人在解放前後的不同境遇,兩姐妹走了不同道路的影片。nn 1935年,浙東山區童養媳竺春花,因不堪忍受虐待而逃跑,進入一個闖蕩江湖的越劇戲班,後與教戲師傅的女兒開陰紅結拜為姐妹。班主阿鑫也是想著在春花身上撈一把才收下春花的

programme.title: 答案在風中
programme.desc: 故事發生在風景優美的中國農業大學校園。戴小明(石展飾)是農大的一名學生,其貌不揚。若不是天生開朗幽默的個性,他幾乎不會引起別人的注意。他文理皆優,惟獨對體育科目十分怵頭--他實在不愛運動。n一次,戴小明被死黨彭誠(劉曉燁飾)生拉硬拽去歡迎

programme.title: 張三豐傳奇之道法自然
programme.desc: 張君寶一直夢到一位老者向他宣講《道德經》,他終日按照夢中老者的指點研習武功。後來他巧遇上官姐弟倆,並成為朋友。因為一隻蛐蛐,上官家被惡霸誣陷,也讓張君寶意識到官府黑暗,致使天下鬥蛐蛐成風而各業荒廢。

programme.title: 門巴將軍
programme.desc: 該片講述了李素芝36年如一日,深入偏遠藏區為活佛僧侶、藏族羣眾和邊防官兵巡診的感人故事。

programme.title: 公證人之真假遺囑
programme.desc: 故事圍繞主人公葉永彬、楊倩等公證人展開,他們作為司法工作人員,堅持職業操守,維護司法公正,通過一份遺囑引發的謎案,揭開人物之間錯綜複雜的關係與情感。

programme.title: 彈無虛發之天國寶藏

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩。當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動。每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力。

programme.title: 仙境森林的祕密 #5 英普
programme.desc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命。

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #5 英普
programme.desc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天。在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥。在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #1 英普
programme.desc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族。另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族。年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?

programme.title: 獮猴島 #2 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期。鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下。目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮。

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #3 英普
programme.desc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環。每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓。深入探索並瞭解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨、甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩。

programme.desc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的祕密信息,然後見證戀愛中的捲尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象。

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #6 英普
programme.desc: 這是澳洲春季的第一天,從風流的樹熊到拳擊袋鼠,再到選擇今天開餐令人驚訝地快速的眼斑巨蜥,獨特的動物們就開始春日狂熱。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #5
programme.desc: 一隻穿山甲被野生動物販運者虐待致死,阿曼達博士的團隊感到心碎,但另一隻穿山甲在康復後歸野,則令他們雀躍萬分。檢查三隻刺蝟,跟隨中心的狒狒和安氏林羚轉換住處。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 準備觀看阿曼達博士冒險嘗試給野馬羚套上頸圈。然後,長尾猴發生騷亂,因此要追蹤藍冕狐猴- 阿藍。檢查一隻長了趾瘤的雕鴞,然後向即將返回野外的鱷魚希拉說再見。

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛。隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭。逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源: 盧安瓜河。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地。大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫。

programme.desc: 一隻穿山甲被野生動物販運者虐待致死,阿曼達博士的團隊感到心碎,但另一隻穿山甲在康復後歸野,則令他們雀躍萬分。檢查三隻刺蝟,跟隨中心的狒狒和安氏林羚轉換住處。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 準備觀看阿曼達博士冒險嘗試給野馬羚套上頸圈。然後,長尾猴發生騷亂,因此要追蹤藍冕狐猴- 阿藍。檢查一隻長了趾瘤的雕鴞,然後向即將返回野外的鱷魚希拉說再見。

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛。隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭。逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源: 盧安瓜河。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地。大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #1 英普
programme.desc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族。另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族。年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?

programme.title: 獮猴島 #2 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期。鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下。目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮。

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #5
programme.desc: 瞭解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略。參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐。

programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩。當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動。每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力。

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #7 英普
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天。環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一羣獨特的動物。

programme.title: 人性之猿: 豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
programme.desc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生。走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一羣行蹤隱祕的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具、與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力。

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演。從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團。

programme.title: 狒狒: 部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族、好戰的沙漠族、紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #10 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一。迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海。這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋。生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海。隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓。深入探索並瞭解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨、甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩。

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓。深入探索並瞭解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨、甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩。

programme.desc: 這是澳洲春季的第一天,從風流的樹熊到拳擊袋鼠,再到選擇今天開餐令人驚訝地快速的眼斑巨蜥,獨特的動物們就開始春日狂熱。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #5
programme.desc: 一隻穿山甲被野生動物販運者虐待致死,阿曼達博士的團隊感到心碎,但另一隻穿山甲在康復後歸野,則令他們雀躍萬分。檢查三隻刺蝟,跟隨中心的狒狒和安氏林羚轉換住處。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #6
programme.desc: 準備觀看阿曼達博士冒險嘗試給野馬羚套上頸圈。然後,長尾猴發生騷亂,因此要追蹤藍冕狐猴- 阿藍。檢查一隻長了趾瘤的雕鴞,然後向即將返回野外的鱷魚希拉說再見。

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛。隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭。逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源: 盧安瓜河。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地。大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫。

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #7 英普
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天。環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一羣獨特的動物。

programme.title: 人性之猿: 豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
programme.desc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生。走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一羣行蹤隱祕的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具、與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力。

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演。從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團。

programme.title: 狒狒: 部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族、好戰的沙漠族、紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #10 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一。迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海。這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地。

programme.desc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲。發掘捲尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇。

programme.title: 人性之猿: 豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
programme.desc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生。走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一羣行蹤隱祕的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具、與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力。

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演。從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團。

programme.title: 狒狒: 部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族、好戰的沙漠族、紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #10 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一。迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海。這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #5
programme.desc: 一隻穿山甲被野生動物販運者虐待致死,阿曼達博士的團隊感到心碎,但另一隻穿山甲在康復後歸野,則令他們雀躍萬分。檢查三隻刺蝟,跟隨中心的狒狒和安氏林羚轉換住處。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋。生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海。隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚。

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #7 英普
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天。環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一羣獨特的動物。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 隨著日照越短、天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9

programme.title: 自然保護區 #2
programme.desc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影。這是一片莊嚴且神聖、亟需我們守護的原始荒野!

programme.title: 自然保護區 #3
programme.desc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點。深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機。

programme.title: 自然保護區 #4
programme.desc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林。這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #1
programme.desc: 艾倫從愛丁堡出發,探索一列奢華列車,與列車主廚會面,造訪二戰與雅各賓紀念地,漫步於莫拉的銀白沙灘,並瞭解西高地鐵路的工程奇蹟。

programme.title: 珍娜·傑克森: 誘惑的藝術
programme.desc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峯。

programme.title: 揭祕芭比: 分裂的夢幻屋
programme.desc: 《揭祕芭比: 分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響。

programme.title: 重塑: 瑪麗蓮·夢露 #1
programme.desc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍。在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以「瑪麗蓮夢露」的身份進入荷里活。

programme.title: 重塑: 瑪麗蓮·夢露 #2
programme.desc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星。

programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯。探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的。

programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣。

programme.desc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。

programme.desc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神祕的地質構造和危險的掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
programme.desc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三週的時間來盡量增加體重。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務。這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人。而且,總能忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物。深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就。還有,努力無堅不摧。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #1
programme.desc: 艾倫從愛丁堡出發,探索一列奢華列車,與列車主廚會面,造訪二戰與雅各賓紀念地,漫步於莫拉的銀白沙灘,並瞭解西高地鐵路的工程奇蹟。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #2
programme.desc: 艾倫在列車上享受水療設施,造訪威姆斯灣,參觀布特島上的斯圖亞特山莊,欣賞珍貴的莎士比亞原稿,探索列車工作人員區域,參與刺激冒險,並造訪皮特洛赫裏的著名山頂劇院。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #3
programme.desc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,瞭解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光。

programme.title: 太空災難 #4
programme.desc: 美國太空總署極力培訓其太空人,確保他們的身體健康、精神強大,並如最強大的機器一樣可靠。不過事實是,即使是最聰明的人也會犯錯……而在太空這個苛刻的環境中,任何錯誤,即使微不足道,都會左右生死。

programme.title: 太空災難 #5
programme.desc: 在惡劣的天氣中飛行是令人痛苦的經驗,而對於美國太空總署來說,可說是倍感不安,因為兇猛的風暴可以不分大氣層上下襲來。

programme.title: 太空災難 #6
programme.desc: 將太空船送入軌道是一項不容有錯的工作。每次發射都是長時間的受控爆炸,最小的誤差可導致火爆的處境。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裏的高峯牧場,瞭解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事。接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉。他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家。他們共同的願景是製作天然、以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術。他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,瞭解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處。他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調。他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長、與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名。他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 隨著日照越短、天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #3
programme.desc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,瞭解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #4
programme.desc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #1
programme.desc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。

programme.title: 太空災難 #6
programme.desc: 將太空船送入軌道是一項不容有錯的工作。每次發射都是長時間的受控爆炸,最小的誤差可導致火爆的處境。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #1
programme.desc: 重新檢視新春攻勢: 兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威。探索報告、圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一。通過新聞片段、任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化。歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
programme.desc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師。隨著深入瞭解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬布拉德利——她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達。透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員。馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
programme.desc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來。在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#76粵
programme.desc: 朋發現老人所弄茶葉蛋比他好，欲改變比賽形式卻失敗，於是問計家人，眾建議朋向他拜師，可惜老人拒絕。簽約作實當日，「廚魔」莊天武現身。當朋著急時，赫然發現廚魔的真正身分，更瞭解這場比試只會自招其辱而已。

programme.title: 尚食#16粵普PG
programme.desc: 皇上最寵愛的幼子衛王在用膳時突然昏迷，胡尚食指孟尚食呈上的鹿角菜有毒，皇上下令把涉事庖廚一律拿下。子衿為救孟尚食和紫萍甘願承受杖責。子衿向皇后示警，善祥診出衛王並非中毒，瞻基決定帶衛王到自己宮中養病。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 本地豬受到嚴格規管，用甚麼飼料可令豬隻增強免疫力，味道亦與別不同？有優質豬，鼎爺亦不吝嗇功夫及時間，巧製一道「水晶豬手凍」來討好阿譚。豬皮要做出外表晶瑩剔透，豬皮膠汁宜蒸不宜煮。鼎爺繼續大顯刀法功架，將木耳、蝦仁、帶子、竹筍、滑豆腐切得盡量幼細，帶來可解油膩的上海菜「酸辣文思豆腐海皇羹」，酸辣開胃。燜煮五花腩是滋味菜餚，鼎爺還於滷水料中加入「四物」食療元素，令香氣更出，尤其適合女士滋補。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「小腸氣」學名為疝氣，是指肚內器官經缺口向外凸出，不一定只關小腸事！外科醫生解釋男士患小腸氣較女士常見的先天結構原因，可怎樣透過手術作治療？脊醫指出，膝關節的骨與骨之間內藏二氧化碳，如壓力增加或勞損會釋出二氧化碳而發出「卡卡聲」；若附隨痛楚，則有可能患上「髕骨股骨疼痛綜合症」？坐在椅子上及準備橡筋帶，隨脊醫做強化肌肉的預防運動！「睇餸食飯」環節，譚詠儀示範「宮保雞丁」做法之餘，也分享餸菜背後故事。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 肥胖不只影響外表，更會引起各種併發症，而世界衛生組織已將肥胖列為疾病。內分泌及糖尿專科胡依諾醫生這集聯同註冊中醫師何慧欣、李澄琳營養師，為大家解構「肥胖症」，同時推薦減肥食療給觀眾。本集更有藝人何依婷分享心理學與肥胖的關係，想知道更多關於這個病症的資訊？切勿錯過這集《醫度講》！

programme.title: 五味人生#8粵PG
programme.desc: 永禎與利是妹從關老太口中聽到雙春的不幸遭遇，利是妹指永禎玩得過火了。月圓之夜，若嵐狂性大發用利剪襲擊雙春…… 酒樓生意門堪羅雀，卻突然有大批客人湧進，原來是永禎使出了「假客人」計畫。勝天發現金鳳竟在這裡義務擔任英文老師，不禁對她另眼相看。義學雖開辦成功，但不少學生因要謀生而沒法上學；勝天提議可實施「上學包午飯」方針。雙春向若嵐說出她的病況，令她大受打擊；為了助若嵐回復記憶，飛揚竟決定下廚煮菜。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神祕的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神祕的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 霹靂舞近年被列入奧運、亞運比賽項目，而這集「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓曾子驊有達廿年霹靂舞經驗，更試過代表港隊參賽！霹靂舞動作基本上可分為搖滾步、排腿、定點、大地板，B-Boy曾子驊即席示範四個元素。小朋友想學跳舞，可如何入手？他細說霹靂舞評分準則，還提到有為小舞者而設的賽事。曾子驊憶述曾負傷出賽，投入舞蹈下暫時忘卻傷痛，並取得佳績，足見他對霹靂舞的熱愛。談到多地選手特點，本港舞者有何突出之處？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 颱風吹襲，阿圓也來到開發中心暫避，蜻蛉跟她學習如何練習揮桿。五十嵐找到一張球場路線圖，上面記載了不為人知的4號洞至6號洞，讓蜻蛉挑戰過4號洞後，五十嵐決定帶她去見設計者垢多先生。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.desc: 油塘一個新盤入夥，冷氣機平臺漏水，浴缸膠邊也裂開有罅隙，應該如何執修？

programme.desc: Ceci與瑞輝、力蓮洽談合作，偕同「新歡」現身，瑞輝發現對方竟是昔日於夜場的舊同事。舊同事帶瑞輝回夜場聚舊，瑞輝發現場面冷清，人事全非。為要留住客人，舊同事以瑞輝的「黑材料」威逼他東山復出。其後，家聰偶然發現瑞輝向別的女人獻殷勤，行為極為過火，遂向力蓮示警。力蓮起初並不相信，後來卻察覺瑞輝確有不妥，於是前往舊同事工作的夜場暗中查探，最終有意想不到的發現……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#13粵PG
programme.desc: 思義在車房巧遇知行，父子因昔日郊野雙屍案再生爭執，思義始終懷疑他參與行劫，甚至涉及姦殺，二人心結難解。惠知原本審理的「蓄意傷人案」，其後牽扯出「少女援交平臺案」，最終揭發更深的黑幕。知行駕電單車遇意外，車尾箱竟散出百萬現金！剛好附近海味店遭爆竊，知行脫不了嫌疑，因而被捕。惟媒體重提雙屍案，質疑知行會獲法官父親包庇，令思義憤而放棄保釋他。「海味店盜竊案」由惠知審理，知行認罪卻拒絕交代剩餘贓款下落……

programme.title: 大生意人#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 依梅挺身為李成治傷換取義軍不殺女村民，平原與李成談判，以麻繩和桐油換取釋放所有女人，李成要依梅待其傷癒才能離開。李成拔營前放走依梅，依梅送上玉觀音，依梅回村，村中有依梅與李成的流言，平原跟依梅聊心裡話

programme.title: 試真D粵PG

programme.desc: 楊光被國棟憤責後，一改懶散態度，積極進取。可人恐懼國棟，每於國棟前表現失準。楊光請孝武教授治療方法。可人往掃墓遇見楊光一家，才發現楊光在家中地位並不予想像中風光。在楊光協助下，可人漸漸克服對國棟的恐懼。家聰與文靜租了已移民朋友Mary居所幽會。家聰有愧於簡潔，一直隱瞞與文靜的事，但文靜欲將戀情公開，家聰感為難。面對畢業試，可人非常緊張，未能發揮應有水準，幸得楊光勉勵，終順利完成考試。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「小腸氣」學名為疝氣，是指肚內器官經缺口向外凸出，不一定只關小腸事！外科醫生解釋男士患小腸氣較女士常見的先天結構原因，可怎樣透過手術作治療？脊醫指出，膝關節的骨與骨之間內藏二氧化碳，如壓力增加或勞損會釋出二氧化碳而發出「卡卡聲」；若附隨痛楚，則有可能患上「髕骨股骨疼痛綜合症」？坐在椅子上及準備橡筋帶，隨脊醫做強化肌肉的預防運動！「睇餸食飯」環節，譚詠儀示範「宮保雞丁」做法之餘，也分享餸菜背後故事。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 肥胖不只影響外表，更會引起各種併發症，而世界衛生組織已將肥胖列為疾病。內分泌及糖尿專科胡依諾醫生這集聯同註冊中醫師何慧欣、李澄琳營養師，為大家解構「肥胖症」，同時推薦減肥食療給觀眾。本集更有藝人何依婷分享心理學與肥胖的關係，想知道更多關於這個病症的資訊？切勿錯過這集《醫度講》！

programme.title: 五味人生#8粵PG
programme.desc: 永禎與利是妹從關老太口中聽到雙春的不幸遭遇，利是妹指永禎玩得過火了。月圓之夜，若嵐狂性大發用利剪襲擊雙春…… 酒樓生意門堪羅雀，卻突然有大批客人湧進，原來是永禎使出了「假客人」計畫。勝天發現金鳳竟在這裡義務擔任英文老師，不禁對她另眼相看。義學雖開辦成功，但不少學生因要謀生而沒法上學；勝天提議可實施「上學包午飯」方針。雙春向若嵐說出她的病況，令她大受打擊；為了助若嵐回復記憶，飛揚竟決定下廚煮菜。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#76粵
programme.desc: 朋發現老人所弄茶葉蛋比他好，欲改變比賽形式卻失敗，於是問計家人，眾建議朋向他拜師，可惜老人拒絕。簽約作實當日，「廚魔」莊天武現身。當朋著急時，赫然發現廚魔的真正身分，更瞭解這場比試只會自招其辱而已。

programme.title: 尚食#16粵普PG
programme.desc: 皇上最寵愛的幼子衛王在用膳時突然昏迷，胡尚食指孟尚食呈上的鹿角菜有毒，皇上下令把涉事庖廚一律拿下。子衿為救孟尚食和紫萍甘願承受杖責。子衿向皇后示警，善祥診出衛王並非中毒，瞻基決定帶衛王到自己宮中養病。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵

高朋滿座#77粵
programme.desc: 大會安排二人進行廚藝比賽前哨戰，朋無奈答應，但天武的廚藝實技高一籌。天武表明早已厭倦比賽生活，求朋一起放棄決戰。慶看出他們在意比賽，勸服二人比拼。二人出盡法寶煮出最得意的菜色，惜二人參賽只是宣傳技倆。

programme.title: 尚食#17粵普
programme.desc: 衛王浪費食物，子衿希望他學會珍惜食物，衛王聽不進耳，還想抓子衿出氣；蘇月華在一帆的幫助下到御前侍奉；她投皇帝所好製膳，使皇帝食用過多葷腥導致流鼻血，郭貴妃知道蘇月華為了上位不擇手段，想廢掉她的雙手…

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 潮州菜中，簡單小食都能盡顯烹調者的功架，鼎爺與阿譚先品嚐潮州美食，再炮製潮州粥，伴以「雜鹹」同喫特別有風味。鼎爺帶來「普寧豆醬浸竹仔魚」，留意剝竹仔魚皮及調較普寧豆醬的方法；而鼎爺在煎魚前先在油中加鹽有何作用？二人在田中揀選又靚又嫩的勝瓜，煮一鍋「勝瓜魚尾粟米湯」，以原條魚尾煲出鮮甜美味。勝瓜亦可用來炮製小炒，配上鮮蝦，營養豐富的白玉木耳，亦加入新鮮百合同炒，若想延長鮮百合的保鮮期，有何保存方法？

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 地中海貧血是遺傳性疾病，患者容易出現貧血，重症者更要終身輸血及定時服用除鐵藥物。血液及血液腫瘤科醫生指，骨髓移植是現時主流根治方法，近年推行的基因治療亦有不錯成效。樹藝師肩負診斷與維護城市樹木的責任，被稱為「樹木醫生」。樹藝師兼攀樹師到來，概述二者的工作分別，並提到日常需面對日曬雨淋的辛勞。嘉賓更和同行創辦攀樹比賽，希望向公眾推廣這項專業。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅帶來「咖哩牛肉焗薯仔」，嫩滑惹味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 你睡覺時，會「打鼻鼾」嗎？你晚上有否因呼吸不順暢而影響睡眠質素？你可能患上「睡眠窒息症」！這集有受到疑似此症影響的藝人朋友何廣沛到來，請教內分泌及糖尿料胡依諾醫生、註冊中醫師何慧欣與李澄琳營養師有關睡眠窒息症的成因及治療方法，並即場面診！

programme.title: 五味人生#9粵
programme.desc: 飛揚完成五色炒飯，若嵐果然憶起了不少昔日事情。雙春把看見飛揚煮菜的技巧全都告訴九妹，九妹試煮，眾人大讚好味。若嵐胡亂用方法欲替自己治病險象橫生；雙春只得再拜託飛揚煮菜卻被推辭。飛揚的太太婉君努力下，飛揚終答應替若嵐煮菜。勝天向父親提出辦慈善舞會，替義學籌經費。鎮長為選出誰主理舞會膳食，讓喜相逢與吉慶樓作廚藝比試；飛揚更答應九妹能在比賽中勝出，便收他為徒。雙春靈機一觸，想到在山中及海邊獵取野味作菜。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」首先帶來關節運動，會模仿小貓、兔子、螃蟹等動物做動作。其中一項訓練是要坐在地上四肢離地，以臀部推動身體向前移，但小朋友們與主持姐姐向前邁進都不算太成功，教練特意再示範其中的技巧要點。教練亦會指導眾人利用阻力帶，開展綜合體適能訓練；透過提升肌肉力量，對日常生活大有幫助。另外，節目還會播放AI生成動畫《園丁和主人》的下半部。

programme.title: 祕密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 近來千依狀態大勇，排名節節上升，甚至宣言要贏得下次偶像公主大賽的冠軍。與此同時，坊間盛傳千依向阿紡發出演唱會邀請，但千依表示完全沒有這樣做。正當千依為此事感到困惑，她背後竟傳來一把神祕的聲音……

programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2787粵
programme.desc: 陳法拉為哥哥陳生物色相睇對象，欲逼使他與陳師奶離婚。陳生因此離家出走，偷偷在接龍超市貨倉借宿，卻被力蓮發現。出於某些原因，璟風收留陳生於自己的住所暫住，陳生服侍周到，城安、壯與凌凌亦得到不少好處，並拿陳生與瑞素比較。瑞素被比下去，感到不快。其後，璟風等人卻察覺不妥，陳生因牽掛陳師奶，作出不少「擾人」行為，眾人不勝其煩，成功找到關鍵人物以解決問題，本以為可順利「送走」陳生，詎料……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#14粵PG

programme.desc: 侯二求見平原被拒，故威脅茶舖不得購買蘭雪茶。平原拜訪胡裕泰，卻因蘭雪茶亂了徽茶規矩被逐，遂以加一成價格收購全村茶葉，並派平文赴山西借銀。李欽承諾助平原進入萬茶大會，結果當日平原沒有等來李欽，焦急萬分…

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 許多港人近年「北上」玩樂，不論食、買、玩、住，想必已有一定心得，大家也希望尋找最高「性價比」的喫喝玩樂地點，獲得滿滿的「情緒價值」。主持江美儀暢遊深圳、珠海、惠州、東莞、潮州、汕頭等廣東省不同地方，每站聯同周嘉洛、朱敏瀚、曾展望、吳業坤當中兩位男拍檔，以顧客的身分測試多款美食可會有「伏」，探索各式玩樂景點值得光顧與否，為香港觀眾提供貼地的參考指數。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
中國香港單車總會呈獻：2026 UCI 世界盃場地單車賽 (中國香港)粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#8粵PG
programme.desc: 簡潔懷疑可人是第三者，一再試探卻不果。簡潔跟蹤家聰，遠處看見家聰和一女子狀甚親熱，但傳呼機急召她回工作崗位，無奈離去。簡潔向文靜透露家聰有婚外情，文靜安慰她。家聰不知有外遇的事已給簡潔發現，仍如常寵愛簡潔，簡潔逃避。家全首次出糧，花大部份薪金買日用品給叔父齊耀、叔母林巧媚及堂弟齊健峯，餘下薪金給巧媚作家用，巧媚卻嫌少，楊光取出千元替家全解圍。楊光與可人首次作談判工作，成功勸服脅持者而廣受讚賞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 每人天生有三對主要的口水腺，包括腮腺、舌下腺、頷下腺，協助口水分泌，它們卻有機會產生結石？耳鼻喉科醫生指出，關鍵在於口水中的礦物質。若情況輕微，有可能會自然排出？如嚴重，或需接受內視鏡微創手術。因刺蝟遺棄潮，嘉賓於十年前成立團體，為被遺棄的刺蝟物色寄養家庭，刺蝟難養嗎？她還提及會到學校出席分享會，讓刺蝟舒緩學童情緒及壓力，如何做到？「睇餸食飯」，Annie示範「韭菜豆醬骨」，鹹香惹味，佐飯一流！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 你有常常出現尿頻嗎？可能已經患上「膀胱過度活躍症」！《醫度講》這集請來方紹聰(奶仔)述說自己尿道的問題，還邀得泌尿外科專科醫生簡煒文為大家解構何謂「膀胱過度活躍症」與其成因，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同李澄琳營養師，會在節目中介紹有助應對不同尿頻問題的建議食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#10粵
programme.desc: 喜伯通知眾人放在酒樓內的野味全數死去；九妹為勝出比賽，竟出錢請神打師傅幫忙，飛揚阻止並帶九妹回家療傷，更開解九妹讓他信心大增。眾人擔心九妹的菜式沒法與吉慶樓的山珍海錯相比，永禎想出替各菜式另起新名稱，務求先聲奪人。鎮長與所長試食後突然腹痛及流鼻血，紛紛暈倒。雙春發現永禎藏有大包瀉藥，不問情由便指他是毒害一眾評判的兇手，永禎憤而離開連家。雙春喝過永禎所煮的湯，認為他是二十年前曾拯救自己與九妹的人……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#78粵
programme.desc: 颱風襲港，眾人希望藉颱風得到假期，翌日果然天從人願高掛八號風球。但因風雨的關係，眾人被困家中閒極無聊，大家玩遊戲解悶時，卻令慶大怒離去。翌日風球依然高掛，但眾人發現高慶夫婦同告失蹤，唯有四出尋找兩老。

programme.title: 尚食#18粵普
programme.desc: 子衿為蘇月華求情，郭貴妃無奈罷休。皇后為瞻基一直沒有子嗣而擔心，故召見子衿，告訴她會立她為太子嬪，子衿婉拒。上元佳節將至，胡尚食要求與孟尚食在百官宴上比試。子衿和紫萍在酒倉查庫存時遇上意外…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 經營近半世紀的眼鏡店舖位細細，雖然「單眼仔睇榜 － 一眼睇曬」，店內多款眼鏡各有特色，還吸引演藝圈「潮人」專誠捧場！香港不乏愛馬之人，許多賽馬術語更已變成流行俚語，學者廖舜禧「出馬」解讀。不少俗語與顏色有關，如「三分顏色上大紅」、「戴綠帽」等，究竟有何出處？「託大腳」原來與中國古代皇帝有關，且聽舜禧逐一拆解。老字號麵店裡，黃耀英「攞住碌竹」學造竹昇麵，卻被吳幸美笑稱「棺材柺杖」，究竟怎麼回事？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 結婚嫁女餅款式多多，美味之餘還各有吉祥寓意，難怪引來「砧板蟻－ 為食鬼」！中秋節臨近，中式餅店師傅講解月餅製作過程。月餅價錢並不便宜，上一代港人還要每月拿出薪金「供月餅」，有何原因？廣東美食仿如「三水佬睇走馬燈－ 陸續有蒞」，但遇見「油炸蟹」、「土鯪魚」卻要避之則吉？乘搭小巴亦可發現香港傳統特色，經典小巴「水牌」更成為至潮香港手信！「寫字人」麥師傅還會親身示範「小巴牌」特色字體。

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視臺EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神祕事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》樸荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 機械城足球隊
programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視臺EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神祕事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》樸荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, he explains that he was miming.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Cause for The Paws
programme.desc: Po, at the top of his game but lonely, comes across two weasels stealing an earthquake causing gauntlet and tries to stop them, but inadvertently destroys a town. He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight’s Code
programme.desc: Po and Blade's personalities clash as they track Klaus and Veruca and fight off some of Po's old foes. Blade gets to see Po's kung fu mastery, but doesn't agree to team up with him until she realizes that he accidentally holds the key to finding Klaus and Veruca: he has a piece of the WuGao Gauntlet. Meanwhile, Klaus and Veruca continue on their path of destruction while looking for the mysterious "Lotus".

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Fall of House Tarron
programme.desc: When General Morando and Colonel Kubritz attack the Mothership, Team Tarron must fight to protect the King and Queen’s Cores and their lives… with shocking, fatal results.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Big Sleep
programme.desc: Aja and Krel travel into their parents’ memories in pursuit of Morando - and the truth about Gaylen’s Core. But when the King and Queen’s lives are jeopardized, a trusted ally makes a sacrifice that will change the team forever.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Race to Trollmarket
programme.desc: With their parents nearly regenerated and Morando in pursuit of Gaylen’s Core, Aja, Krel, and Vex unite with Toby and Arrgh on a quest into the depths of Trollmarket to unearth the relic before it ends up in the wrong hands.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - No Can Do Adopt-A-Toad
programme.desc: Chet is determined to open a giant can of tomato juice lands in town and Turbo worries that Chet is becoming obsessed with the can. Turbo donates his race winnings an animal charity, but accidentally adopts a toad who moves into the clubhouse and becomes an obnoxious house guest.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Buster Move Gills!
programme.desc: Smoove Move is embarrassed when his nerdy brother comes to visit. Skidmark causes a panic when he hunts a snail-eating goldfish at a fancy party.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Stuck in Skates Lawn Circles
programme.desc: After ice skating with his pen pal, Archibald can't remove his too-tight skates. Crackridge has crop circles. Could aliens really be responsible?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Toyland Mischief Maker
programme.desc: When Big Ears' teapot goes missing, Noddy is surprised to find it hanging from a lamp post. And when Bumpy's kennel goes missing too, it's clear there's a mischief maker in Toyland. Noddy needs to investigate before Toyland descends into chaos. Using his investigating kit and with Revs and Bumpy to help, Noddy discovers that it was the Naughticorns playing a game of Dare and daring each other to do silly things.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Popping Balloons
programme.desc: Noddy and his friends are each given a balloon at the end of Smartysaurus's Science Party. But when lots of the balloons start going pop, Noddy decides to investigate why. Realising that someone must be hiding and popping them, he follows the clues to PatPat and then to the Naughticorns before eventually working out that the balloon poppers are the Ninjas.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Pink Lettuces
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening at the farm - all Farmer Tom's lettuces have been painted pink! Farmer Tom is really upset so Noddy offers to investigate. After talking to PatPat and Smartysaurus he realises that the Ninjas had asked Smartysaurus to make them pink paint so that they could paint the lettuces. They were using them as pom-poms to cheerlead Pink Ninja as she ran the Toyland Marathon Race! The Ninjas are very sorry that they upset Farmer Tom but he tells them that it's alright.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Jigsaw Puzzle Pieces
programme.desc: When some pieces from Big Ears' jigsaw puzzle go missing, Noddy investigates: where are the missing pieces? He soon realises someone must have taken them and draws up a list of suspects. Having discounted the Pirates and then the Naughticorns, Noddy is baffled. But when Pat-Pat and the Pockets invite him to share a piece of toy cake, Noddy suddenly has a breakthrough: maybe it wasn't one toy who took lots of pieces but lots of toys who each took one piece.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Bees Sting
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Bees didn't sting. All the animals loved the Bees and they especially loved their sweet and yummy honey. The trouble was all the precious honey was disappearing and there was a honey crisis in Tinga Tinga. Something had to be done. Luckily clever old Tortoise has a cunning plan. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Peacock Struts
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Peacock didn't strut. He was a very proud bird and he wanted to be the best at everything. He wanted to be the best bird-brain in Tinga Tinga. Everyone offers to help set up for the picnic but Queen Sparklewings tells them not to worry - the fairies can do it all. Later, when Noddy and all his friends are approaching Fable Forest Station on the train they discover someone has redirected the train tracks. They can't get to Fable Forest. How will they have the picnic in time? Noddy needs to investigate why the train tracks have been moved.

Noddy decides to investigate: who is the mysterious King of Toyland? He spots the Knights carrying a royal litter, but all he can see inside is the top of an orange crown. Realising the King's favourite colour must be orange, Noddy remembers seeing Pat-Pat painting a bowl of oranges and wonders if she knows who the King is.

The action hero toy tells him that he only took back his specially decorated balloon. The others were still there earlier.

They discover that Cloppycorn has been taking the gold from the pot to give his unicorn horn a special golden glow.

Realising that magic is involved, Noddy goes to see Queen Sparklewings to see if she can help but she tells him her wand has gone missing. Someone must be trying to do magic with her wand! Meanwhile more flying toys appear, first Fuse and then Smartysaurus.

But when Noddy arrives at the party, the other toys are all scared by a strange noise. Noddy decides to investigate: what's making the scary noise? Using his investigating skills and following all the clues, Noddy arrives at the Naughticorn Stables where he realises that the scary noise is actually a slowed down tune on the music player.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Upset Animals

Using his wwwbook to gather clues and using all his investigation skills Noddy travels all over Toyland to find out what has been disturbing the animals. He works out that the new stickers that PatPat gave to the the animals are made out of glow in the dark paper.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Aardvark Has A Sticky Tongue
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Aardvark didn't have a sticky tongue. He had a long nose, big clumsy paws and he found it very difficult to eat. Then one day Aardvark's tongue got stuck in the honey log! All his friends pulled and pulled until KERPLING! Aardvark's tongue finally came unstuck. From that day on Aardvark's tongue was all long and sticky - perfect for eating yummy termites. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Whale Spouts
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Whale didn't spout. Then one day there is a big storm in Tinga Tinga. The winds blew stronger and the ocean waves got bigger and bigger. Suddenly an enormous wave picks up Whale and carries her all the way from the ocean to the Waterhole. SPLOSH! But Whale was so full of water that she couldn't move! How do the animals help Whale get back to the ocean? For once, Elephant has the answer. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Space Suit

Julian's excited but so is Pat, who has always yearned to be an astronaut. He's even more thrilled when he finds that his special delivery is a space suit - an extra surprise for the kids. When his van breaks down in a snowy lane, he finds an ingenious solution - only to suffer a puncture - and Ted is unable to help...

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Stormy Birthday

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dancing Queen

Noddy goes back to Toy Green to tell Big Ears all about it and narrowly misses being run over by the runaway Pirates Galleon. Someone has taken their sticky anchor and without it they've no way of stopping the ship! Noddy needs to investigate before there's an accident! He soon works out that Bling was in Fuse's Workshop but it turns out that she just went in to add a Special Thing to Fuse's collection. More clues lead Noddy to Smartysaurus. She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there.

He realises that the grey coins are actually the gold coin covered with paint. They're not the only things that have turned grey too - Deltoid's shiny gold medal has been painted grey too.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Easter Kitty Bunny

When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Anchor

Noddy goes back to Toy Green to tell Big Ears all about it and narrowly misses being run over by the runaway Pirates Galleon. Someone has taken their sticky anchor and without it they've no way of stopping the ship! Noddy needs to investigate before there's an accident! He follows all the clues which leads him to the Knights.

Did the Naughticorns take them for their obstacle course? Or was it Farmer Tom who used them to keep his animals under control. Noddy carefully follows the clues and at last discovers it was the Pirates who took them to use as markers for Stripes' Pirate Galleon Driving Test.

She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Grey Coins

For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Stuff Campout

programme.desc: Shadow and Skidmark embark on a perilous adventure through the zoo to rescue Deuce.Whiplash attempts to keep the crew from meeting his parents.

programme.desc: While serving as Finly's magical assistant, Archibald gets lost in a spooky mansion. Archibald helps a grumpy hermit crab find a new shell.

programme.desc: Cloppycorn is in charge of the Swapsy Game. Everyone puts a toy into the Swapsy Wagon and takes a toy out! It's brilliant fun - until the fairies yo yo. disappears from the wagon altogether. Cloppycorn's very upset. No one will trust him to pull the wagon again! Noddy tells him not to worry. He's going to investigate and help Cloppycorn find the missing toys.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Unhappy Unicorn
programme.desc: Cloppycorn is very upset unhappy because his special felt ball, Snuggleball, is missing. Noddy needs to investigate quickly! He follows the clues around Fable Forest and discovers that PatPat broke snuggleball by mistake when she rode over it with her scooter. Noddy asks PatPat to make a new snuggleball but Cloppycorn doesn't like it. It doesn't feel cuddly like his special toy. Clever Noddy asks everyone in Toyland to give the new snuggleball a big hug.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Sticker Mystery
programme.desc: New stickers, with a picture of a mysterious bandit, have appeared in Toyland. Clockwork Mouse begs Noddy to investigate. He finds himself going head to head with jealous Hoof who wants to prove that Noddy isn't the only investigator in Toyland. Hoof thinks he's solved the case in no time, but Noddy's attention to detail makes him realise the bandit isn't quite what he seems.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Stolen Treasure

Oh no! Noddy needs to investigate at once. A strange new galleon appears on the horizon. Could it be Tina the Terrible? Has she stolen the treasure? Using all his detecting skills Noddy follows the clues to the DareDale Caves where he realises that the ship on the horizon isn't Tina the Terrible's galleon at all.
